title: AFK Chat Spammer
description: Lets your friends know you're AFK by automatically sending a custom chat message on a timer you control. Fabric + NeoForge.
body:
# AFK Chat Spammer

Stepping away but don't want your friends to think you vanished? AFK Chat Spammer automatically
sends a chat message you write, on an interval you set, so anyone watching chat knows you're
still around — just AFK. Handy for parties, servers with active chat, or just letting friends
know you're grabbing a snack instead of ignoring them.

100% client-side: no server-side install, no server mod required, works on any server that lets
you chat.

## Features

- **Custom message** — write exactly what you want your friends to see.
- **Configurable interval** — pick how often it repeats, down to the second.
- **Toggle on/off** on the fly, from chat or a GUI.
- **In-game config screen** via Mod Menu (Fabric) or the native Mods screen (NeoForge).
- **Fabric and NeoForge** support from one project.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/afkspam on` \| `off` \| `toggle` | Enable / disable / flip the spammer |
| `/afkspam status` | Show current settings |
| `/afkspam message <text>` | Set the message it sends |
| `/afkspam interval <seconds>` | Set how often it sends (min. 1s) |

## Requirements

- [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (Fabric only)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) (optional, Fabric — for the config screen)

Note: Quilt is not currently supported — Quilt Loader and Quilted Fabric API have no build for
Minecraft 26.2 yet.
